units.source_text: 翌晨，名人在澡堂旁的廊子上让别人修面。

en.t: The next morning, the Master had someone shave him on the veranda beside the bathhouse.

units.source_text: 大概是为明日参加战斗，修修边幅。

en.t: It was probably so he could tidy himself up before taking part in tomorrow's contest.

units.source_text: 现有的椅子没有靠背，夫人靠在他后面，顶着他的脖颈。

en.t: The chair there had no backrest, so his wife leaned against him from behind, bracing the nape of his neck.
